description: FREE headline pre-check (100/day per wallet; pass caller). Returns assessability only - whether the artefact is in the published submission form for one op; no lint findings are returned.

artefact.description: The one unsigned payload artefact in the published submission form for the op (EVM: the EIP-712 descriptor form; SVM: the instruction-descriptor form). Processed in memory only, never stored, never signed.

caller.description: Solana base58 wallet of the operator; keys the free allowance (100/day per wallet).

name: payload_preflight_precheck
